senses.gloss: m. h. a. ch. (περίζωμα) girdle, apron; (also collect.) aprons.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 11a:12">Succ. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>רמא … לפ׳ דאינשי ביתיה</he> (Ms. M. <he>פרזימא</he>; Ms. M. 2 <cite ref="Q01663"><he>פרוזמא</he></cite>) attached show-fringes to the aprons (of the women) of his household; <cite ref="Menachot 43a:11">Men. 43ᵃ</cite> (Ms. M. <he>פרזי׳</he>; Ms. K. <he>פירזו׳</he>).—Pl. (Hebr.) <he>פִּרְזוֹמָאוֹת</he>, <he>פִּרְזוֹמָיוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 125a">Sabb. 125ᵃ</cite> <he>פרזומי׳</he> early eds. (Ms. M. <he>פרזמ׳</he>, later ed. <he>פרוזמ׳</he>, Ar. <he>פרוזמא׳</he>).—V. <cite ref="Q01799"><he>פְּרִיזוֹמָטָא</he></cite>.
